headline: France Just Unveiled Its First-Ever Esports Nations Cup Jersey
dek: Thousands gathered on the Champs-Élysées for an Esports Festival, where Team France revealed its kit for the upcoming Esports Nations Cup.
body_markdown:
Paris's iconic Champs-Élysées recently transformed into a vibrant hub for gaming enthusiasts, hosting the Esports Festival by the Esports World Cup 2026. On Sunday, August 2, thousands of fans descended upon the historic avenue, turning it into France's largest free public celebration of esports. This event marked a significant pivot for the Esports World Cup, extending its reach beyond conventional competitive venues and into the heart of public spaces, aiming to draw in a wider audience.

A standout moment of the festival was the much-anticipated public unveiling of an official national kit for the inaugural Esports Nations Cup (ENC). The Team France jersey, a product of collaboration with adidas, made its debut, offering a tangible symbol of national representation within the burgeoning world of esports. This reveal signals a new chapter, where national pride takes center stage in competitive gaming.

The jersey's debut sets the stage for the Esports Nations Cup itself, an event poised to redefine global esports competition. Slated to take place in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, from November 2

29, 2026, the tournament will bring together players from more than 100 countries and territories. These athletes will battle it out across a diverse roster of 16 different games, highlighting the event's truly global scale and competitive variety.

Further cementing the growing infrastructure around the Esports World Cup, Saudia has stepped in as the Official Airline. The partnership was visibly underscored by the unveiling of a branded EWC Aircraft, demonstrating the expanding commercial interest and robust logistical backing now supporting the Esports World Cup and its associated events. The sky's the limit for national esports ambitions.
